message.content: {"items":[{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) – Rolling Cross-Section 2009-2013","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA5300","justification":"Core GESIS study on voting behaviour, party preferences, and political attitudes around the 2009–2013 federal election period in Germany, directly capturing political behaviour and attitudes in the early 2010s."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) – Campaign Panel 2013","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA5700","justification":"Panel survey of the 2013 federal election campaign in Germany with rich measures of political attitudes, turnout intentions, and vote choice in the mid‑2010s."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) – Post-Election Cross-Section 2013","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA5701","justification":"Nationally representative post‑election survey for the 2013 Bundestag election, focused on electoral behaviour and political attitudes in Germany."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) – Campaign Panel 2017","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA6800","justification":"Panel data around the 2017 Bundestag election capturing political preferences, party evaluations and participation, squarely within the 2010s."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) – Post-Election Cross-Section 2017","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA6801","justification":"Post‑election study for the 2017 federal election that measures turnout, vote choice, and a wide range of political attitudes in Germany."},{"title":"Political Attitudes, Political Participation and Democracy in Germany 2014 (Allbus / German General Social Survey – Special Module)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA5250","justification":"Special module focused on political attitudes, satisfaction with democracy and participation behaviour in Germany mid‑decade (2014)."},{"title":"ALLBUS 2012 – German General Social Survey 2012","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA4610","justification":"Includes modules on political interest, trust, left–right self‑placement and party closeness, offering a broad picture of political attitudes in Germany in the early 2010s."},{"title":"ALLBUS 2014 – German General Social Survey 2014","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA5240","justification":"Provides nationally representative measures of political interest, trust in institutions, and party identification during the mid‑2010s."},{"title":"ALLBUS 2016 – German General Social Survey 2016","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA5252","justification":"Covers political attitudes, values, and some aspects of participation in Germany, useful for analysing political behaviour in the latter half of the 2010s."},{"title":"Political Participation and Opinion Formation in Germany 2015","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA5859","justification":"Study directly focused on forms of political participation (e.g. voting, contacting politicians, protests) and opinion formation processes in Germany in the mid‑2010s."}]}
